title: Extract advance_state_counter_in_tx helper in kith-store
description:
What: The pattern of incrementing a state counter inside a transaction (SELECT + UPDATE on state_counters) is duplicated across message.rs, contact.rs, chat.rs, and outbox.rs. Extract it into a private fn advance_state_counter_in_tx(tx: &Transaction, type_name: &str) -> Result<i64, KithError>.

Algorithm:
1. Read each of message.rs, contact.rs, chat.rs, outbox.rs; identify all advance_state_counter call sites inside transactions
2. In kith-store/src/lib.rs (or a new state.rs submodule), add:
   pub(crate) fn advance_state_counter_in_tx(tx: &Transaction<'_>, type_name: &str) -> Result<i64, KithError>
   - SELECT current_value FROM state_counters WHERE type_name = ?
   - new_value = old + 1
   - UPDATE state_counters SET current_value = new_value WHERE type_name = ?
   - Return new_value
3. Replace every inline duplicate with the helper call
4. Ensure the helper is NOT pub — it is an internal primitive

Defensive programming rules:
- The helper must run inside the caller's transaction, not open its own — signature takes &Transaction<'_>
- Do not change the transaction open/commit pattern at any call site — only replace the counter increment lines
- Run the full kith-store test suite after each file replacement; do not batch all four at once
- Check cargo clippy -p kith-store after each file to catch import errors

Agent team: R+I+T agent per file (4 files), or single agent working through files sequentially

Tests:
- cargo test -p kith-store passes with all 70+ existing tests unchanged
- cargo clippy -p kith-store -D warnings passes
